༄༅/ /man ngag rin po gser gyi sgrom bu zhes bya ba bzhuṭa so/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /man ngag rin po gser gyi sgrom bu zhes bya ba bzhuṭa so/

/ rin chen shog skya'i skor/ / rgya gar skad du/ rat+na u pa de sha so nā dzā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ man ngag rin po che gser gyi sgrom bu zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rang bzhin sems pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /'od gsal rin chen gdangs lnga'i sku/ /'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thogs ma'i kun tu bzang po dang*/ khams gsum srid pa'i sems can kun/ /ji ltar byung dang 'khrul dang grol/ /rgyal ba'i lung la brten nas bshad/ /de yang gzhi lam 'bras bu las/ /gzhi la ka dag lhun grub ste/ /snang stong 'du 'bral med par gnas/ /rig pa 'od lnga'i klong dkyil na/ /ma bying ma rmongs nang gsal nyid/ /phyi ru ma 'phros bum skur gnas/ /de tshe gang du'ang ma nges pa/ /thog ma'i spyi gzhi zhes bya 'o/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /mes chen zhes kyang de la zer/ /de nas skye med bsam yul 'das/ /thog ma'i ka dag ngang nyid las/ /lhun grub 'od lnga phyir shar bas/ /thugs rje rig pa'i gdangs nyid kyang*/ /de dang mnyam du rig ste shar/ /dper na shel gong dag pa la/ /rnam lnga'i 'od dang phra phro'i 'od/ /ji ltar mnyam du shar ba bzhin/ /de nas rig pa yon tan nyid/ / yul la 'byed cing rtog par shar/ /'od lnga'i gdangs la 'di snyam du/ /'di ltar snang ba'i rang bzhin las/ /bdag nyid byung ngam 'od snang 'di/ /rang las byung zhes dpyod pa na/ /skad cig de la rang rig pas/ /thog ma'i kun tu bzang po ni/ /gzhi thog nyid du byang chub bo/ /de ltar rang 'od shar ba la/ /rang du ma shes gnyis 'dzin mthun/ /de tshe 'dzin pa'i sems de la/ / rtsa ba'i ma rig zhes bya 'o/ /sems de rags par med pas na/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ /yod min med min zhes bya ste/ /myu gu'i sems zhes de la bya/ /de tshe kun bzang chen po de'i/ /ka dag ngang las sku sprul pa/ / dgu phrugs rim gyis ston pa yi/

/longs sku sprul sku'i snang ba las/ mi mjed la sogs 'jig rten gyi/ /thog ma'i mgo yang brtsam par mdzad/ /de nas sems can sems nyid des/ /ci yang med par 'khrul pa dang*/ /sa gzhi rgya mtsho'i bar chags te/ /rnam shes nam mkha' mtha' yas 'khrul/ /de tshe rgya mtsho 'khrugs par snang*/ /de nas gzugs khams yas rim chags/ /de tshe ri dang gling rnams kyang*/ /mas rim grub ste 'dod pa'i lha/ /ri rab dag la brten nas byung*/ /de tshe sprul sku'i chos sku yang*/ /ston pa'i thugs rje 'od zer las/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams bzhi/ /'og min rnam snang phyogs bzhir snang*/ /de ltar zhing lnga'i ston pa las/ /sprul sku longs sku'i rnam 'phrul te/ /snang ba dam pa la sogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas stong sprul sems can btul/ /de dag kun las rnam 'phrul ba/ /sprul pa'i sprul pa zhes bya ste/ /bzo dang skye ba la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar 'khrul pa'i sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po snying la gnas/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ka dag la/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gdangs dang bcas/ /thugs rje 'gags med rig pa gsal/ /zer dang gdangs su 'phro ba'o (< a > gdangs su 'gro ba 'o ) / / lus kyi rtsa bdun srog rtsar brten/ /de ltar brgyad la rlung gi rtas/ /rig pa snying gi gdangs khur bas/ /rnam par shes pa zhes byar btags/ /sems ni rlung can grong nas rgyu/ /dbang po lnga las phyir thon nas/ /yul 'dzin pa la so sor 'jug /bag chags sna tshogs sogs pa 'o/ /ye shes snying na gnas pa'i gdangs/ /dung khang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rtsa rnams nang na sgrom mar gsal/ /thig le thig phran 'od lngas brgyan/ /de ltar snying nas ye shes gdangs/ /dar dkar rtsa nas rgya mtshor shar/ /sprin med mkha' la snang ba 'o/ /de ni gzhi yi bzhugs tshul lo/ /da ni lam gyi 'khyer tshul la/ khregs chod thod rgal rnam gnyis so/ /de yang shel gyi phra phro ltar/ /sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i sems 'di nyid/

/ye shes gdangs te ngos gzung med/ /snga phyi da lta du yang med/ kha dog dbyibs med mtshan ma med/ /de ltar lta bas thag bcad nas/ /dbang po rab 'bring tha ma yis/ /de nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /tha mas rtog pa rtsad bcad la/ /skye 'gag med pa'i ngang la gzhag /'bring gis phaṭa ces rang ngor blta/ /rbad kyis bcad nas phyam gyis gzhag /rab kyis gang shar ye shes gdangs/ /spang blang 'dzin med rang sar grol/ /thog babs gang shar rang 'gros gtang*/ /yangs so che 'o rig pa'i sems/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i yul rnams la/ phyod de bun ne 'dzin pa med/ /gang shar rtog pa rol du chug /yengs dang ma yengs bsgom du med/ /lta dang mi blta dpyad du med/ /thams cad kun bzang rol par khyer/ /de ltar gzhi rtsa chod pa des/ /lus dang yul gyi rdos bcas nyid/ /'od gsal ngang du grol bya'i phyir/ /bzhugs stangs gsum la gzhi byas te/ /gzigs stangs gsum gyis gnad bkrol nas/ /skyes pa bud med bye brag gis/ /rgya mtsho g.yas g.yon rig pa gdon/ /dbyings kyi ngang du lu gu rgyud/ /'gul 'khrigs med par bzhag pa la/ /mig gtad sems kyis bzung mi bya/ /'od snang chags zhen med pa blta/ /de tshe chu yi sgron ma las/ /phyi dbyings nam mkha' sprin bral la/ /nang dbyings rnam dag sgron ma ni/ /'ja' 'am rma bya'i mdongs ltar 'char/ /de nas thig le stong sgron na/ /lnga ldan 'od kyi mu khyud can/ /sum sbrel la sogs shar ba'i dbus/ rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /phra la 'gro 'ong byed pa ni/ /mi 'gul mig gis lta ba dang*/ /rlung ni kha nas drangs pa yis/ / gsal stong skye med lhag shar ba/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma ste/ /de nyid ngang la rgyun du bzhag /bying rgod byung na rab gsal te/ /zas gos bsil la lta stangs bstod/ /gnas ni dngas shing mtho sar bsgom/ /nyams ma 'phel na spyod pa bya/ /dur khrod lung stong la sogs su/ /smyon pa lta bu'i brtul zhugs kyis/

/cir snang dgag sgrub med par spyad/ /mngon zhen dgag sgrub rang sar grol/ /mtshan dus 'od gsal snying la bsdu/ /rang gsal 'od lnga'i pho brang na/ /'od gsal rigs lnga snang ba la/ /ma yengs shes pa skye med bzhag /gnyid rnams 'od gsal chos skur grol/ /ldang dus snang srid chos sku'i zhing*/ /sems can lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ /'gro kun lha yi dkyil 'khor la/ /grags pa'i sgra rnams sngags su shes/ /dran rig rang grol chos nyid ngang*/ /snang srid sgyu ma'i lam khyer bya/ /nyal dus gzhi bral gdod ma'i ngang*/ /chos kun mnyam pa chen po ru/ /skye med 'od gsal goms par bya/ / nyi ma'i phyogs nas khru gang sar/ /mig gtad zur la bags kyis khrid/ /de yis 'od snang 'char ba yin/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad phebs te/ /phyi nang rdos bcas rtog mtha' zad/ /de tshe 'khrul snang longs skur zad/ / longs sku nyid kyang 'dzin med par/ /ka dag ngang du mya ngan 'da'/ /ji ltar sngon thog nyid kyi gzhi/ /thim la ma rmugs bum pa'i sku/ /nang gsal phyi rgya ma ral ba/ /rang ngo nang bltas thams cad mkhyen/ /rnam pa'i yul rnams phyi rol mkhyen/ /gdul bya gzigs nas sku 'gyed de/ /ngo bo nyid kyi chos sku las/ /lhun grub longs sku rigs lnga'i gdangs/ /de las sna tshogs sprul pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don kun rab rdzogs nas/ /thog ma'i ngang du slar thim 'gyur/ /de ltar rab tu brtson pa yis/ /lo drug phung po lhag med 'grub/ / brtson 'grus 'bring rnams 'dir sbyong nas/ /chos nyid bar dor mya ngan 'da'/ /de yang skye gnas bar ma dor/ /dam pa'i drung du sems thag bcad/ /dang por thos pas thag bcad de/ /cir snang ye shes lhun grub gdangs/ /byung tshor rnam rtog ye shes dngos/ /yin min rol par ngang gcig ste/ /gzhan snang med de rang snang dngos/ /thams cad ye yin ye shar du/ / snang sems lta bas thag bcad nas/ /bar du de nyid 'di ltar bsgom/

/nyin dus chos nyid bar do la/ /lhun grub 'od lnga'i rtsal sbyong bya/ /'jug dang shes pa grol ba'i gnad/ /rnal 'byor pa yis shes par bya/ /nyal dus dbang po'i 'gags tshul dang*/ /bar do'i gdams pa dran par bya/ /gnyid dus 'od gsal sems nyid la/ /goms pas gdod ma'i ngo sprod dran/ /rmi lam bar do'i 'char tshul du/ /ngos gzung yang yang rtsal sbyang bya/ /sad dus sngar bzhin gsal gdab bo/ /tha mar de nyid goms pa yis/ /dus kun bar do dran pa dang*/ /phyogs bzhi gsum gnyis mdun ngos tsam/ /'od kyi snang bas khyab pa dang*/ /sems la dgag sgrub rnam rtog chung*/ /'khrul pa'i rmi lam rgyun chad dang*/ /cir snang gang shar 'dzin pa med/ /gar gtad ting 'dzin shes pa gnas/ /rtsa bral ka dag rtogs par ldan/ /de ltar goms pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'chi kha'i bar do gsal gdab ste/ /rang rig gdon la slar gdab bo/ /bla ma'am ni rdo rje'i spun/ /dam tshig ldan pas dran pa gso/ /bar dor 'char ba'i rang snang la/ /rang snang nyid du shes par mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs zhes lan gsum brjod/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi/ /rang rang la ni thim dus su/ /shes pa mig nas mkha' la blta/ /sngar gyi gdams pa dran par bya/ /rnam shes nam mkha'i ngang du thim/ /de tshe sems rig dbugs dang bral/ /rig gdangs rta yang nam mkhar yal/ /nang dbugs chad de nam mkha' 'dra/ /'dzin pa'i sems nub gzung ba thim/ /phra rags rnam rtog rang nub ste/ /nam mkha' 'od gsal thim pa'i tshe/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i 'od gsal ni/ /ka dag nam mkha' 'dra ba la/ /lhun grub nyi zla gza' skar ltar/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i snang ba 'char/ /la la 'di nas grol ba yod/ /'od gsal zung 'jug thim pa'i tshe/ /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor snang ba ste/ /sgra 'od zer du 'khrigs pa dang*/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mngon par snang*/ /rang snang shes pas grol ba yin/ /de nas zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung*/

/snang mtha' don yod grub pa ste/ /so so'i yab yum sems dpa' dang*/ /sems ma sgo ma'i rang bzhin rnams/ /zhag lngar rim gyis 'char ba yin/ /de tshe rang lus 'od gsal gyi/ /snying ga nas ni zer thag byung*/ /'od lnga'i tshom bu'i thugs kar 'brel/ /rig pa 'od la 'jug pa ste/ /snang ba de kun rang yin pas/ / dpag chen mnga' yi gdams pa ni/ /tshom bu'i thugs kar rang rig 'phangs/ /'dres pas mi rtog ting 'dzin 'byung*/ /de la sems gzung rang sa zin/ /skad cig gsum la grol ba yin/ /sprul pa bkye nas don byed do/ /de nas gdod mar rab thim gyur/ /de ltar ma gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /snang ba de kun zer thag la/ /'dus nas rang la thim pa ni/ /'od ni rig par 'jug pa ste/ /de tshe ma pang bu 'jug ste/ /gdams ngag 'di ltar dran par bya/ /rang shar rang snang rang la thim/ /de nyid rang la sems bzung ste/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin mnyam gzhag pas/ /rang grol gzhan snang sprul pa 'gyed/ /ka dag ngang du mya ngan 'da'/ /gdod ma'i sa la mthar phyin no/ /de la nges pa ma rnyed na/ /zung 'jug ye shes la thim tshe/ /ye shes bzhi sbyor snang ba 'char/ /snying ga nas ni nam mkha' la/ /'od kyi nyi zhur rtsegs ma ni/ /mthing ga dkar ser dmar ba'i gdangs/ kha dog mthun pa'i thig les brgyan/ /de tshe rang snang mi 'gyur ba/ /gser gyi thur ma'i gdams ngag ni/ /'od dang thig ler sems bzung bas/ /ka dag sa la btsan sa zin/ /de la nges pa ma rnyed na/ / ye shes lhun grub thim pa'i tshe/ /phyogs rnams ston ka'i nam mkha' ltar/ / snang ba mu khyud lnga dang ldan/ /kun gyi nang na lha yi sku/ /zhi dang khro tshul dpag med snang*/ /yar la ka dag zad sa mthong*/ /mar la rigs drug snang ba mthong*/ /bar du 'ja' tshon lha sku mthong*/ /de tshe rang snang rang rig pas/ / dpag chen mda' ltar phyir mi ldog /'char tshul brgyad dang mngon shes drug /rjes dran drug gis mthar phyin ni/

/rol pa'i rtsal du thim tshul brgyad/ /de ltar rim gyis snga phyi ru/ /grol ba sngar gyi goms pas bzung*/ /skad gcig dang por rang ngo shes/ /gnyis par mi rtog bsam gtan skye/ /gsum par gzhi thog grol ba yin/ /'di la dbang po'i khyad par gyis/ /phyogs bzhi 'od snang rtogs par ldan/ /bco lnga'i nyi zla 'char nub bzhin/ /dbugs chad grol ba dus mnyam mo/ /'bring rnams 'od gsal zung 'jug grol/ /tha ma ye shes lhun grub la/ /nges pa rnyed nas grol ba yin/ /tha mas sprul pa mi 'byin zhes/ /rgyud dang man ngag dag las gsungs/ /ye shes lnga sbyor mi snang ba/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /ka dag grol gzhi ljang gur gnas/ /de nyid mi snang de yi phyir/ /ye shes bzhi sbyor snang bar 'dod/ /de'ang bar dor snang ba la/ /skad cig rang ngo shes tsam gyis/ /grol ba gzhi snang mthong ba dang*/ /'od lus yin par shin tu sla/ /dper na rmi lam 'jigs skrag la/ /rmi lam shes pas skad cig la/ /snang ba rang log bde ba bzhin/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la skad cig gis/ /rang gnas ka dag chen por grub/ /dbang po 'bring gi grol lugs so/ /tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing*/ /bar do med par grol ba ni/ /tshe 'dir 'od gsal goms gyur nas/ /shes rab rtogs par mi ldan pas/ /rmi lam bzang bar gyur pa de/ /snang srid rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing*/ /sems can lha dang lha mo ru/ /'gro 'chag nyal sad snang ba dang*/ /spyod lam kun tu dran par bya/ khyad par mi gnas rang rig ni/ /skabs su sprul sku'i ston pa nyid/ /bsam pa'i thugs kar 'phangs par bya/ /'chi dus rig pa mig nas ni/ /sprul sku'i zhing dran de ru 'phangs/ /de la goms pa mchog gyur pas/ / dbugs chad mngon dgar skye ba mnyam/ /'bring dang tha ma'i spyod yul ni/ / bar do rnams kyang rim shar nas/ /lhun grub nub dang dus mnyam du/ /chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

/mngon dga'i zhing du rdzus te skye/ /tha mas srid pa'i bar do nyid/ /nyug tsam shar nas mngon dgar skye/ /yang mthas srid pa'i bar do ru/ /ring zhig lon nas rmi lam bzhin/ /mngon dga'i zhing du skye ba yin/ /de tshe mngon dga' rdo rje'i zhing*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong nas/ /chos thos zhe sdang nyid dag ste/ /me long ye shes de yis thob/ / de nas bar do mi snang bar/ /skad cig rdzus ste dpal dang ldan/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbang bskur nas/ /nga rgyal dag cing mnyam nyid rtogs/ /de nas pad+ma brtsegs pa ru/ /snang ba mtha' yas lung bstan nas/ /'dod chags dag ces sor rtogs thob/ /las rab grub par dbugs phyung nas/ /phrag dog dag byed bya ba grub/ khro bo'i zhing mthong skad cig la/ /bden pa mthong nas rnam par grol/ /lhun grub ka dag nyid thim nas/ /ka dag nang gsal chos sku la/ /rang sa zin te 'du 'bral med/ /gdul bya gzigs nas sprul pa 'gyed/ /de yang lhun gyis grub par 'byung*/ /gdul bya zad nas sprul pa yang*/ /mi gnas gdod ma'i ngang du thim/ /de ltar sangs rgyas chos rnams kyang*/ /'bad med rang sar grol ba yin/ /ji lta ji ltar sems can gyi/ /bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab ltar/ /de lta de ltar sangs rgyas kyi/ /grol ba'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /la lar thun mong rgyu 'bras te/ /grangs med bskal pas grol ba dang*/ /la lar 'bras bu lam byed pas/ /bcu drug skye bas grol ba dang*/ /la la tshe gcig grol lo zhes/ /pha ma gnyis su med rgyud du/ / gsungs shing bstan yang dgongs don tsam/ /sangs rgyas snying po 'od gsal zhing*/ /tshe 'dir rdos bcas mi nub pas/ /yang dag ma yin nges don min/ / 'dir ni kun tu bzang po yis/ /mchog gsang yang rab dbang po la/ /chos kyi sku yi bstan pa ni/ /bla med rdo rje snying po gsungs/ /de yis tshe 'di'i longs sku'i zhing*/ /bgrod nas chos sku mthar phyin 'gyur/

/gzhan rnams sprul sku'i bstan pa ste/ /sems las sangs rgyas grub par rlom/ /'dir ni sems las sangs rgyas med/ /ye shes 'od gsal lam byed pas/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la mthar phyin na/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu 'od gsal te/ /sems ni rigs gdangs rlung ltar zhon/ /sgyu lus zhig tshe 'dor bar 'dod/ /de phyir kun dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /dam pa'i snying gi snying po'i lam/ /snying tig gsang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /shin tu yang zab kun gyi rtse/ /grol ba rnams kyi mthar phyin to/ /rgyal sras pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /dri med 'od zer rnal 'byor pas/ /ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du/ /man ngag gser gyi sgrom bu bkod/ /dge bas srid gsum sems can kun/ /'od gsal zhing du grol bar shog

/man ngag rin po che gser gyi sgrom bu zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi mkhas pa chen po rang byung pad+ma'i byin rlabs las/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang du thos pa'i nang nas/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo bzhin mngon par mtho ba'i pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /dge zhing bkra shis pa lags so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)man ngag rin po gser gyi sgrom bu/ -PAGE 146--PAGE 145--PAGE 144-
